title: test/e2e: migrate to `PodmanExitCleanly()` helper (tracking)
body:
`PodmanExitCleanly()` (introduced in 0c18beaea7) replaces the three-line pattern:

```go
session := podmanTest.Podman([]string{"foo", "bar"})
session.WaitWithDefaultTimeout()
Expect(session).Should(ExitCleanly())
```

with:

```go
session := podmanTest.PodmanExitCleanly("foo", "bar")
```

New tests should use the helper (see https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/pull/30251#discussion_r4587440259), but about 4,000 old-style calls remain across about 130 files in `test/e2e`, and new contributors copy them.

Convert in small per-file or few-file PRs, following previous conversions (e.g. de1aa44cc9 for `attach_test.go`, 6ad44fe179 for `play_kube_test.go`), so reviews stay manageable and conflicts with open PRs stay small.
